purpose: Teach: 変態/下痢/淘汰/封鎖/犯す/駆除/悟り/生ずる

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、昆虫の変態現象を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on insect metamorphosis, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, attentive opening. Gentle confirmation in her voice—checking in with a student she notices. Clear and steady, no rush.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、感染症由来の下痢の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I actually wrote mine on diarrheal infections from infectious disease.
lines.style: Straightforward, slight correction underneath. Not defensive, just clarifying what she actually did. Direct eye contact level.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 市場による淘汰現象を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: I see. And you examined market-driven selection phenomena in your work?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Gentle curiosity, not interrogation. Listening between the lines of what Sakura actually said.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、道路封鎖時の経済影響を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Right—my topic was the economic impact of road closures.
lines.style: Clear and steady. No apology in her tone. She's answering the question directly, matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史上、罪を犯す者の心理を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Mm. In history, you explored the psychology of those who commit wrongdoing?
lines.style: Genuine, engaged curiosity. Lean in slightly—she's really trying to understand what Sakura was researching. Warm but professional.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、害虫駆除の科学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I focused on the science of pest control and elimination.
lines.style: Patient, quiet clarity. Not irritated by the mismatch, just correcting the record. Holds her own without defensiveness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 修行による悟りの過程を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And through training and discipline, you examined the path to enlightenment?
lines.style: Reflective, slower tempo. She's genuinely wondering where Sakura is going with all this. A small smile underneath—not mocking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、気候変動から生ずる紛争を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No—I wrote about conflict arising from climate change.
lines.style: Final, clear answer. She's said it plainly now. No frustration, just done. Small pause at the end, letting it land.
